findings.summary: Essential UI does not consistently meet contrast requirements.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed color-contrast and link-in-text-block; the page relies on color for some links.
findings.suggestedFix: Use tested foreground/background tokens and non-color link affordances that survive high-contrast modes.

findings.summary: Representative content routes are interrupted by bot verification.
findings.evidence: Homepage initially rendered the age gate, but the detail route screenshot later showed Cloudflare “Verify you are human”; raw detail HTML was available while the rendered journey could not continue.
findings.suggestedFix: Tune bot protection so legitimate browsers can reach age verification and content, and add a clear retry/support path when challenge completion fails.

findings.summary: Load performance is inconsistent and can miss the good LCP threshold.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 5.6s and performance 0.74, although a separate trace measured LCP 1.545s; the variance itself signals an unreliable load path.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the true LCP asset, reduce challenge/third-party variability, and validate field LCP/INP/CLS across uncached visits.

findings.summary: Several controls and frames lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed iframe-title and link-name. The live DOM has two iframes with empty titles and search/login text inputs without associated labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful iframe titles, real labels for every input, and discernible text or aria-label for icon/ad links.

findings.summary: Text and link contrast is below WCAG minimums.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed its color-contrast audit and reported links distinguishable only by color.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust theme tokens to meet WCAG contrast and underline links in text rather than relying on color alone.

findings.summary: The viewport explicitly disables user zoom.
findings.evidence: DOM contains maximum-scale=1.0,user-scalable=0 and Lighthouse failed meta-viewport; this prevents users from magnifying content.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions; keep responsive reflow and adequately sized controls.

findings.summary: Content Security Policy is missing.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive confirms HTTPS, HSTS, nosniff and X-Frame-Options, but no Content-Security-Policy header is served.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP in report-only mode, inventory required origins, then enforce it without unsafe-inline/eval.

findings.summary: Third-party requests and statistics calls begin before meaningful consent.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 32/55 third-party requests and 424,378 third-party bytes, including AgeVerif statistics and advertising origins; trackers found eight external origins before the user completed verification.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize pre-consent calls, document necessary verification processing, gate analytics/ads on consent, and proxy or self-host essential assets where appropriate.

findings.summary: Bot-defense runtime behavior can replace real pages with an unproductive challenge.
findings.evidence: Detail and 404 screenshots showed Cloudflare verification instead of route content; the 404 capture was nearly blank while raw HTML returned a meaningful recovery page.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a robust challenge failure state, preserve page context, avoid repeated challenges, and allow retry/support without losing the destination.

findings.summary: The experience does not adapt its palette to the user color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Desktop and prefers-color-scheme:dark screenshots are effectively identical; the site is hard-coded dark and the white age-verification card remains white.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use preference-responsive surface tokens with light-dark() or prefers-color-scheme.

findings.summary: Modal UI is implemented as custom divs instead of native dialog primitives.
findings.evidence: Probe found role=dialog on a DIV, but zero <dialog>, popover, or details elements; login/reset and age UI depend on custom behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for modal account flows and declarative popover/details for transient or disclosure UI, preserving focus and light dismiss.

findings.summary: Several interactive targets are too small for reliable touch use.
findings.evidence: The live probe counted 18 visible links/buttons/inputs under 24px in width or height at desktop; Lighthouse also reported links with weak discernibility.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase control hit areas toward 44x44 CSS px, retain visible focus, and provide non-hover affordances.

findings.summary: The first action is vague and gives no decision context.
findings.evidence: The full-viewport age card says only “Start” and “We must check your age,” with no method, privacy link, provider explanation, or alternative before transfer to AgeVerif.
findings.suggestedFix: Rename the action to describe the verification step and disclose method, provider, data use, privacy terms, and recovery options in the gate.

findings.summary: The critical path contains avoidable render-blocking resources.
findings.evidence: HAR identified seven VeryHigh-priority parser-inserted stylesheets plus parser-inserted jQuery and AgeVerif scripts; Lighthouse estimated 680ms render-blocking savings and weak font/cache delivery.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, defer noncritical plugin styles/scripts, use font-display, and load verification code at the latest safe point.

findings.summary: Heading order does not reflect the visual reading hierarchy.
findings.evidence: The live heading sequence begins H3 Categories, H3 Tags, H2 sections, then reaches the page H1 near the footer; this weakens structural navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Place the page H1 first in main content and nest H2/H3 sections in logical order; verify keyboard focus order alongside it.

findings.summary: Some images lack intrinsic dimensions.
findings.evidence: Images primitive found two images without width/height; Lighthouse unsized-images also failed partially.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width and height matching intrinsic aspect ratio to logo/decorative images and preserve aspect-ratio in responsive CSS.

findings.summary: The browser reports deprecated APIs and inspector issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found three deprecation warnings from the Cloudflare challenge script and cookie issues in DevTools.
findings.suggestedFix: Update or configure third-party challenge code to supported APIs and resolve emitted cookie/inspector issues.

findings.summary: At least one prominent ad card is not a crawlable link.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors for article.ad > a with no href; the probe counted three #/#! or missing destinations.
findings.suggestedFix: Give genuine navigation controls real href destinations and use buttons for in-page actions.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only and omits modern credential support.
findings.evidence: Login markup exposes username and password fields, with no WebAuthn/passkey registration or authentication affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkeys/WebAuthn alongside fallback recovery and use correct username/current-password autocomplete tokens.

findings.summary: Referrer Policy is missing and browser defenses are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive found no Referrer-Policy; CSP/frame-ancestors is also unavailable, although X-Frame-Options and Permissions-Policy are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter Referrer-Policy and fold clickjacking protection into CSP frame-ancestors.

findings.summary: The stylesheet is heavily tied to physical left/right layout.
findings.evidence: DOM CSS contains extensive margin-left, padding-left/right, text-align:left/right and directional positioning, with no evidence of a logical-property strategy.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace physical spacing/positioning with inline/block logical properties and test translated/RTL layouts.

findings.summary: Sign-in and search inputs omit autocomplete assistance.
findings.evidence: Live forms probe found null autocomplete on username, password, reset-email, and search fields.
findings.suggestedFix: Add username, current-password, email, and search autocomplete/inputmode tokens as appropriate.

findings.summary: Account access lacks phishing-resistant authentication and clear modern recovery affordances.
findings.evidence: The account surface offers username/password login and lost-password reset only; no passkey management or reauthentication flow is exposed.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey sign-in/management, preserve a clear recovery route, and require reauthentication for sensitive account actions.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes through legacy formats and oversized variants.
findings.evidence: Images primitive found 42/42 images in JPEG/PNG, 12 oversized, 10 eager below-fold, and zero AVIF/WebP assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP srcsets, right-size candidates, lazy-load below-fold cards, and preserve eager priority only for the LCP image.

findings.summary: Third-party resources consume most transferred bytes without a stated budget.
findings.evidence: HAR attributed 424,378 of 696,392 transferred bytes to third-party origins and loaded multiple ad/stats/verification services before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a per-template third-party budget, defer nonessential media/scripts, and remove vendors that do not justify their byte/privacy cost.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt rather than continuity-preserving.
findings.evidence: The live style probe found no view-transition marker and navigation is a traditional MPA with no cross-document transition declaration.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive cross-document View Transitions for list-to-detail and filter navigation, with a no-motion fallback.

findings.summary: The long catalogue has no scroll-state navigation feedback.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout is 6,187px tall, while the CSS/DOM probe found no scroll-state query, shrinking header, or progress indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll progress or state-aware sticky header using declarative scroll-state/scroll-driven CSS.

findings.summary: Reusable content cards do not use component-level responsiveness.
findings.evidence: The rendered stylesheet probe found no @container rules; catalogue cards are reused across sidebar and main grids.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card containers container-type and adapt card composition with @container queries, retaining viewport fallbacks.

findings.summary: Plugin and third-party code ships before it is needed.
findings.evidence: HAR loaded 16 scripts and seven stylesheets; Lighthouse found about 11KiB unused CSS plus unminified CSS/JS savings, including Contact Form 7 assets on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Conditionally enqueue WordPress plugin assets per template, remove unused styles, and defer third-party code.

taskList.title: Use tested foreground/background tokens and non-color link affordances that survive high-contrast modes.
Tune bot protection so legitimate browsers can reach age verification and content, and add a clear retry/support path when challenge completion fails.
Prioritize the true LCP asset, reduce challenge/third-party variability, and validate field LCP/INP/CLS across uncached visits.
Add meaningful iframe titles, real labels for every input, and discernible text or aria-label for icon/ad links.
Adjust theme tokens to meet WCAG contrast and underline links in text rather than relying on color alone.
Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions; keep responsive reflow and adequately sized controls.
Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP in report-only mode, inventory required origins, then enforce it without unsafe-inline/eval.
Minimize pre-consent calls, document necessary verification processing, gate analytics/ads on consent, and proxy or self-host essential assets where appropriate.
Provide a robust challenge failure state, preserve page context, avoid repeated challenges, and allow retry/support without losing the destination.
Declare color-scheme and use preference-responsive surface tokens with light-dark() or prefers-color-scheme.
Use <dialog> for modal account flows and declarative popover/details for transient or disclosure UI, preserving focus and light dismiss.
Increase control hit areas toward 44x44 CSS px, retain visible focus, and provide non-hover affordances.
Rename the action to describe the verification step and disclose method, provider, data use, privacy terms, and recovery options in the gate.
Inline only critical CSS, defer noncritical plugin styles/scripts, use font-display, and load verification code at the latest safe point.
Place the page H1 first in main content and nest H2/H3 sections in logical order; verify keyboard focus order alongside it.
Add width and height matching intrinsic aspect ratio to logo/decorative images and preserve aspect-ratio in responsive CSS.
Update or configure third-party challenge code to supported APIs and resolve emitted cookie/inspector issues.
Give genuine navigation controls real href destinations and use buttons for in-page actions.
Offer passkeys/WebAuthn alongside fallback recovery and use correct username/current-password autocomplete tokens.
Set a strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter Referrer-Policy and fold clickjacking protection into CSP frame-ancestors.
Replace physical spacing/positioning with inline/block logical properties and test translated/RTL layouts.
Add username, current-password, email, and search autocomplete/inputmode tokens as appropriate.
Add passkey sign-in/management, preserve a clear recovery route, and require reauthentication for sensitive account actions.
Generate AVIF/WebP srcsets, right-size candidates, lazy-load below-fold cards, and preserve eager priority only for the LCP image.
Set a per-template third-party budget, defer nonessential media/scripts, and remove vendors that do not justify their byte/privacy cost.
Add progressive cross-document View Transitions for list-to-detail and filter navigation, with a no-motion fallback.
Add a lightweight scroll progress or state-aware sticky header using declarative scroll-state/scroll-driven CSS.
Give reusable card containers container-type and adapt card composition with @container queries, retaining viewport fallbacks.
Conditionally enqueue WordPress plugin assets per template, remove unused styles, and defer third-party code.
